title: Paper Mario Style Mystery Game
author: ExoHerb
selftext:
Okay so i decided to take a swing at my favorite games and mash them up. Paper Mario, Silent Hill and Resident Evil. This demo of my game is like 2 days old. Ai sucking at art is so real. I feel like i have the vibe for the idea correct, but a long way from what i am dreaming of for this game. 

next is to work on the environments and give the characters more stills and life.

the extra combat video in the comments is a creature i created to see what that would be like.  
  
also in the comments is the dream board i have been using.
